```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : A ⊆ B ↔ A ∩ B = A := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext x
    split
    · intro h1
      exact h h1
    · intro h1
      exact Set.mem_inter_iff.2 ⟨h1, Set.mem_set_of_eq h1⟩
  · intro h
    intro x
    intro h1
    have h2 : x ∈ A ∩ B := Set.mem_inter_iff.2 ⟨h1, h x h1⟩
    exact Set.mem_set_of_eq h2
```
